issue.title: Restore gate creator handoff exports removed by coder-recovery refactor
issue.description:
Proposed by sase-zt.5 note #1, independently reproduced during sase-zt landing
at f3a39fa835. Agent-side LaunchApproval writes a pending gate then fails to
import maybe_handoff_gate_from_agent. The direct import alone reproduces it.

Root cause is standalone tale commit 71717d95a0: it replaced the original
creator-handoff implementations in src/sase/gate_shell/handoff.py with new
coder-recovery logic, while src/sase/gate_shell/__init__.py still lazily exports
maybe_handoff_gate_from_agent, will_handoff_gate_to_agent_runner and
GATE_PENDING_MARKER from the replaced module. Production callers remain in
src/sase/agent/launch_request.py, src/sase/main/gate_handler.py and
src/sase/xprompt/workflow_hitl_gate.py. The ImportError occurs outside the
LaunchRequestError handling branch and leaves the pending gate stranded.

Restore the creator-side handoff API in an appropriate module, repair the lazy
exports, and retain the newer coder-recovery API. Verify marker writes,
intentional runner termination, non-agent behavior, failure rollback and all
three real caller paths without terminating the test process. Regression tests
must call the real handoff adapter with only the final termination primitive
controlled, so mocked callers cannot hide missing exports again.

Size medium: the deletion and restoration boundary are known, but the same
creator API has multiple production entrypoints and recovery/rollback behavior
that must be verified together. This predates sase-zt. All-status task searches
and last-week sweep found no duplicate. Active approval/requester epics are
related consumers; the deletion was a separate standalone tale, not their
implementation. Do not broaden this into all gate/remote-approval work.

task_type_fields.impact: Agent-side launch, generic gate and HITL creation cannot cleanly hand off to the gate shell; pending approval bundles can remain after the command crashes.
task_type_fields.repro: On f3a39fa835, run .venv/bin/python -c "from sase.gate_shell import maybe_handoff_gate_from_agent": ImportError. Original independent runtime report is sase-zt.5 note #1: sase run creates a pending LaunchApproval gate then raises the same ImportError.
